scope: Existing main release plus account-deletion guest-score repair, Apple confirmation explanation and version preparation.
account_deletion_fix: Signed-in replay scores no longer write into the guest personal-best cache.
Confirmed account deletion rebuilds the guest best from retained guest history.
Account history/outbox deletion continues to preserve other accounts and Photos exports.
Deletion confirmation uses the approved wording: “Confirm your identity with Apple to delete your Juggle Dude account.” Native Apple verification is unchanged.

simulator_regression.scope_note: Completed before the deletion-message-only update; subsequent focused UI verification is recorded with local build artifacts.

verification.isolated_postgres_tests: passed, including recorded/imported score cascade and other-account preservation
verification.production_deletion_audit: read-only: 1 Auth account, 1 profile, 36 sessions; no orphan profiles/sessions or pending deletions

submission_instruction: Push main and install the updated local build for user testing. After the user confirms the test, create a fresh archive and upload to App Store Connect. Do not submit to App Review or release without separate explicit instruction.
before_submission: Physical-device check of the exact candidate, including disposable Apple account deletion and revocation.
Confirm purchase, recording/replay/export behavior on the candidate.
Prepare the requested physical-device review walkthrough and updated notes for RF-DETR.
Confirm the App Store version field matches the candidate before selecting its build.
Wait for the user local-test result before archiving/uploading, and separate explicit authorization before App Review submission.
known_limitations: Legacy guest scores without retained guest history cannot be distinguished from contaminated account scores and are not preserved through account-deletion cleanup.
The inherited main build has existing Swift concurrency warnings; this release preparation does not change the camera pipeline.
Recording startup timing and blurred-ball replacement limitations from build 23 remain; newer feature-branch fixes are excluded at user request.
